## Scientist-in-the-Loop Modeling Cycle

```{mermaid}
%%| echo: false
%%| fig-width: 11
flowchart LR
    A["1. Scientist Spec<br/>(Objective, Priors, Guardrails)"] --> B["2. Agent: Data QC & EDA<br/>(Flags, NCA, Plots)"]
    B --> C{"Scientist<br/>Review Gate"}
    C -->|Revise| B
    C -->|Approve| D["3. Agent: Model Runs<br/>(Base → Covariates → VPC)"]
    D --> E["4. Agent: Diagnostics<br/>(GOF, Tables, Summary)"]
    E --> F{"Scientist<br/>Decision Gate"}
    F -->|Iterate| D
    F -->|Sign-off| G["5. Reproducible Report<br/>(Quarto + Audit Trail)"]

    style C fill:#fef3c7,stroke:#d97706,color:#0f172a
    style F fill:#fef3c7,stroke:#d97706,color:#0f172a
    style G fill:#dcfce7,stroke:#16a34a,color:#0f172a
```
